items.preText: 7:28 pm Changes on both sides for this crucial clash ahead! For Galle Gallants, Thomas Rogers comes in for Nurul Hasan. And for Colombo Kaps, Ripon Mondol replaces Shahnawaz Dahani. Dasun Shanaka is unwell, so Charith Asalanka takes the reins as Galle Gallants captain today. Shanaka is still named as an impact substitute and will be available to bat if needed. One last huddle for the Kaps near the ropes, and the players are out in the middle now. Thomas Rogers and Sam Harper stride out to open the innings for the Gallants. Mujeeb Ur Rahman has the new ball in hand. Ben McDermott: "We've had a good few games now, and the boys have bounced back really well. It's been a bit of a difficult two or three games, but I think that can happen in franchise and tournament cricket. When you lose your top one and two draft picks for most of the season, I think we've done quite well considering those losses in Kusal Mendis, so hopefully we can get back into the finals, his body's okay, and we're firing at the right time. We've got the right combinations. It's still a nice wicket here in Kandy, probably one of the best in the country with good pace and bounce. It's nice we've got another game here, and hopefully we can finish off with a win. Death bowling's been a bit of a problem for us so far, but everyone knows that to win a competition you need good death bowling - that's what wins you tournaments. So yeah, hopefully the boys can learn from some mistakes, get that right for the last group game we've got here in Kandy, and push on for the finals in Colombo. I've played in this competition before a couple of years ago for Dambulla. Really loved it then and really loving it now. The people are awesome, and the coaching staff here in Colombo has been excellent, really welcoming, along with all the locals and everyone." Pitch Report from HD Ackerman: "We have been trying to see something in the surface that offers assistance, but we haven't found anything. Maybe today there will be something for the seamers early, as there has been a lot of rain in Pallekele. The covers have been on and off all day. The teams batting first have won games here, so what surprises me is that the Kaps have opted to bowl first. Big scores put real pressure on the chasing side. There are a few things bowlers can use. One tactic that has been underutilized on this deck is the slower bouncer - your initial reaction is either to duck or hit it. The other option is wrist spinners. They can take the ball away from batters by bowling leg-spin to right-handers and the googly to left-handers. Just don't be predictable. If you are chasing here, 200 is tough. Anything around 180 or less, and you have a real chance." Galle Gallants XI: Sam Harper (wk), Thomas Rogers, Dinura Kalupahana, Charith Asalanka (capt), Sahan Arachchige, Chamika Karunaratne, Dasun Shanaka, Mohammad Nawaz, Tharindu Ratnayake, Akif Javed, Sachindu Colombage Colombo Kaps XI: Rubin Herman, Sadeera Samarawickrama (wk), Kamindu Mendis (capt), Ashen Bandara, Janith Liyanage, James Neesham, Milan Rathnayaka, Wanuja Sahan, Malsha Tharupathi, Ripon Mondol Colombo Kaps won the toss and elected to bowl first Shadow-Shell: "Since there's only 5 teams and 20 matches, why are 4 of them(80%), qualifying for playoffs? Couldn't they have 3 instead like WPL?" Interesting insight, I was actually wondering about that too. ICYMI: Dambulla, Colombo, Jaffna, Galle make late changes as playoffs race heats up 6:55 pm We're now at the business end of the tournament, with both teams playing their final league stage fixture before we head into the knockouts. A spot in Qualifier 1 is right up for grabs. The Gallants currently hold the edge in second place with a superior net run rate over the Kaps. The Kaps enter this fixture on the back of a 4-wicket victory over the Dambulla Sixers, thanks to a collective effort from their top order. Meanwhile, the Gallants are looking to bounce back after a disappointing display in the fielding department and with the ball, dropped points despite posting 208 on the board, falling victim to a heroic, match-winning knock by Lahiru Igalagamage for the Kandy Royals. Looking at their last five head-to-head encounters, the Gallants hold the slight advantage with three wins to two. Toss and team news coming right up! 6:45 pm The last time these two sides faced off was way back in the early stages of the tournament in match number 3. Kaps skipper Kusal Mendis smashed 79, alongside Ben McDermott's 57, to set a formidable target of 189. However, the Gallants chased it down comfortably by 5 wickets, powered by Sam Harper's 65 and key contributions from the middle order. 6:38 pm Hello, hello, hello! Hope you are all having a great day, night, or evening, wherever you are tuning in from around the world! Welcome to Cricinfo's live ball-by-ball coverage of the Lanka Premier League 2026. It's match number 19: Galle Gallants taking on Colombo Kaps, live from the Pallekele International Cricket Stadium. I am Rashad Mahbub, and I'll be bringing you all the action today. Hop on board, folks - Pallekele has been serving up high-scoring, competitive thrillers so far, and today promises to be no different!

items.text: Floated a length ball on the stumps with a hint of turn. Samarawickrama premeditates the reverse sweep and mis-times it towards short third. Malinga tracks back and keeps his composure there, times his jump at the edge of the circle and completes the catch.

items.preText: Kamindu Mendis is the new batter in at number 4
items.text: back of a length ball jabs it to mid-on for a single
fuller length ball works it away to long on

dismissal.text: PHKD Mendis lbw b Mohammad Nawaz 1 (2m 2b 0x4 0x6) SR: 50

items.text: That's plumb and Mendis bites the dust! Back of a length ball pitching around the fifth stump line and spins in a wee bit, keeps a bit low and Mendis is caught inside the crease, plays the stroke late and misses the length. The ball strikes the back pad in front of the stumps, and a relatively easy decision for the on-field umpire in the end.

items.preText: Ashen Bandara is in at number 5. Colombage to bowl now
items.text: back of a length ball punches it to cover
pitched up front on the stumps, plays the reverse sweep and the backward point fielder cuts it off
length ball on the leg stump line, moves onto the back foot and inside edges to short fine leg
quicker length ball on the pads, squeezes it to deep square leg
length ball works it away for a single
fuller length ball paddles it to short fine leg and sets off for a quick single

items.preText: Nawaz to bowl out
items.text: pitched up front delivery swept away to deep square leg
full and drifts away down the leg-side
fuller length ball drags it down to midwicket
arm ball on a length around off, carves it down to deep cover

dismissal.text: KNA Bandara st †Harper b Mohammad Nawaz 3 (6m 4b 0x4 0x6) SR: 75

items.text: Nawaz keeps on hurting the Kaps! Generously flighted a length ball around the fourth stump channel, deviating enough to beat Bandara's wild swing of the bat as he dances down the track early and gets nowhere near the line of the ball. Easy piece of glovework by Harper behind the stumps.

items.preText: James Neesham is in at number 6
items.shortText: Mohammad Nawaz to Neesham, no run
items.text: Flighted a good length ball on the stumps, defends on the track
good length ball spins back in on the stumps, taps it with the inner part of the bat to the left of midwicket

items.preText: Ratnayake returns to the attack
items.text: good length ball knocks it to cover area
Up and over! Length ball outside the off stump channel, makes room outside leg and lofts it high over the deep cover area, just evades the two sweeper fielders converging there
length ball swats it down hard to the left of deep cover for a couple of runs
Slower through the air ball on a fuller length, opens the full face of the bat and tonks it straight of long off, one bounce and reaches the ropes
back of a length ball on the stumps, turns it down to square leg
good length ball prods it down for a single
fuller length ball outside off, driven with intent to deep cover, Arachchige fumbles while gathering the ball and the batters complete the double

fuller length ball plays the slog sweep towards deep midwicket. Ratnayake comes around, caught in two minds about whether to go for the catch or not, decides to opt for the latter one and collects it on one bounce.
length ball non-turner outside off, dabs it to backward point, Kalupahana misfields this time

dismissal.text: BR McDermott c Rogers b Colombage 38 (43m 28b 4x4 1x6) SR: 135.71

items.text: McDermott departs! Floated a fuller length ball around off, gets down on one knee and whacks it with the inside part of the bat towards long on. He knew trouble was invited as soon as he mis-hit the ball. Rogers rushes to his left side and gobbles it up near the ropes.

items.preText: Janith Liyanage is in at number 7
items.text: length ball glances it to short fine leg
looped up a fuller length ball outside off, plays the reverse sweep and mis-hits to short third
fuller length ball around off, strides out of the crease and tries to hit through the line of the ball, connects the leading edge towards covers
quicker and fuller on the leg stump line, premeditates the reverse sweep and nails it, had to put in extra effort to loft it over the backward point fielder. 100 up for Kaps.

dismissal.text: J Liyanage lbw b Ratnayake 5 (5m 3b 1x4 0x6) SR: 166.66

items.text: flighted a length ball on the off stump line, played the paddle sweep and did not connect, struck the front pad. The umpire looks convinced and raises his finger. Liyanage reviews it straightaway. Seems like no bat or glove involved, yeah, confirmed by the Ultra Edge now. That's plumb as it gets. Pitching in line, impact is in line and hitting the middle-off stump. More trouble for Colombo Kaps!

items.preText: Malsha Tharupathi is in at number 8
items.text: arm ball on a length outside off, driven to deep cover
length ball pitching well outside off, caught the batter by surprise as the ball spins away sharply
good length ball on the stumps, prods it down on the track
Floated a low full toss and Tharupathi dances down the track, inside edges onto the turf and Harper fails to gather the ball behind the stumps.  A tough stumping chance goes begging!
full on the stumps, nails the paddle sweep and struck it cleanly to deep backward square leg

Poor stuff from the fielder there. Length ball flighted outside off, plays the reverse sweep and hits it straight to short third. Javed, the fielder there, makes a half-hearted attempt to stop the ball and lets it go roll towards the boundary cushion.

Through everything now! Fuller length ball on the pads with a hint of turn, plays the reverse sweep and does not connect. Harper fails to get his body inside the line of the ball, and it races away to the ropes
Muscles it away! Length ball quicker outside off, shimmies down the track and smashes it straight and flat over long on
googly ball around the off stump line, lofts it towards long on and falls short of Karunaratne there

dismissal.text: JDS Neesham c Rogers b Malinga 20 (24m 15b 2x4 1x6) SR: 133.33

items.preText: Malinga in
items.text: Well, that should be the game for the Gallants! Slower through the air on a length, gets underneath the line of the ball and whips it away, only managing to sky it high towards midwicket. Two fielders converge and Rogers calls for it, covers plenty of ground and dives in full stretched under the night sky to gobble it up. Brilliant stuff!

items.preText: Milan Rathnayaka is the new batter in at number 9
items.text: good length ball on the stumps, tucks it to midwicket
pace off length ball sliding down the leg-side
fuller length ball knocks it to mid-on
short pitched ball angling away around off, gets on top of the bounce and drags it down firmly, places it wide of long on
good length ball plays with soft hands to cover and rotates the strike
Fetch that! Pace off fuller length ball and offers width outside off, moves towards the line of the ball and flays it towards widish long off for a maximum!

items.preText: Colombage to bowl out
items.text: good length ball turns in on the pads, plays across the line and hits the front pad
googly ball outside off, play and a miss by Rathnayaka
length ball pitching outside off, knocks it across the line to long on
length ball on the off stump line, driven with soft hands to cover

too full and turns away outside off, Tharupathi steps out of the crease to go big, extends his arms and fails to connect, and immediately plants his right foot inside the crease. Was Harper a bit slow to react behind the stumps, looks like Tharupathi is safe for now.
length ball non-turner on the stumps, plays the reverse sweep and edges onto the front pad. Soft appeal for LBW from the bowler and the keeper, but the umpire looks uninterested.

That's a massive hit! Long hop ball turning away outside off, gets underneath the line of the ball and clobbers this one high into the long on stands. After some juggling and parrying games, the ball is caught in the gallery!

items.preText: Power Blast is on. Here's Ratnayake
items.text: length ball on the off stump line, swing and a miss, thuds the pad
wide ball spins away outside off
length ball outside off, hacks it down on the track
length ball spins away around off, swats it down hard to deep cover
length ball on the leg stump line, moves forward and negates it to deep midwicket for a couple of runs
fuller length ball plays off the front foot and inside edges to the on-side area
flighted a fuller length ball, heaves it away to widish long on and completes the double

items.preText: 52 runs needed off 24 balls. Can these two batters pull off a miraculous win? Akif Javed returns.
items.text: Fuller length ball from around the wicket, 144.2 kph, works it away to long on
hard length ball slaps it down the track to straight of long on
full on the pads, hoicks it with the inside part of the bat to midwicket
You can't set a field for those! Pitched up front around off, gets inside the line of the ball and whacks it through the covers!
Pace off length ball in the slot, picks up the slower delivery and hammers it over long off for a six!
Edged and flies to the ropes! Hard length ball pace on around the fifth stump line, throws his bat at it and gets the leading edge, evades the short third fielder

items.preText: 34 runs needed from 18 balls. Here's Eshan Malinga.
items.text: starts with a widish yorker outside off, play and a miss by Rathnayaka
yorker ball darted wide outside off, shuffles across to reach for it, fails to connect again
fuller length ball hoicks it down the ground to long on
Bowls a widish full toss ball outside off, hangs back and extends his arms, toe-ends the ball and uses the pace of the ball to guide it towards deep third ropes

dismissal.text: M Tharupathi c & b Malinga 36 (29m 15b 3x4 3x6) SR: 240

items.text: Straight up in the air and that's taken! Slower through the air ball on the stumps line, advances down the track and goes for the big hit across the line, miscues it into the night sky. Malinga settles underneath, holds on to it using the reverse cup technique and then collapses on the turf. A sigh of relief for the Gallants as they managed to get the wicket of the dangerous Tharupathi.

items.preText: Wanuja Sahan is the new batter in
items.text: Bowls another widish yorker ball, pitching inside the off-side tramline, play and a miss by Sahan

items.preText: Akif Javed to bowl the 19th over. 29 runs needed off 12 balls.
items.text: Just the start the Kaps wanted! Javed bowls a length ball in the slot. Rathnayaka clears his front leg and smashes this one through the line of the ball, depositing it into the long off advertisement board!

items.shortText: Akif Javed to Rathnayaka, no run
items.text: bouncer ball angling in and cramped the batter for space, tries to swing it away awkwardly and connects the bottom part of the bat
hard length ball on the pads, forces it to midwicket and Javed chases it down

items.preText: Javed misses his run-up. He has to go again
items.text: short pitched ball around off, swing and a miss. The batters scamper across for a quick single

dismissal.text: RMMP Rathnayaka c Karunaratne b Akif Javed 21 (28m 19b 1x4 1x6) SR: 110.52

items.text: Rathnayaka has holed out at deep midwicket! Pace off shortish ball on the stumps channel, plays the swivel pull shot and fails to generate enough power to clear the ropes. Karunaratne moves a few steps forward and grabs it comfortably.

items.preText: Ripon Mondol is the last batter in
items.text: slowr bouncer ball whips it away to deep midwicket for a single. Tidy stuff from Akif Javed in the end.

items.preText: 20 runs needed from the last over. Malinga to bowl now.
items.text: yorker ball darted on the stumps, digs it out with the toe-end of the bat and Malinga cuts it off with a one-handed effort to his left side
Pierces the gap! Fuller length ball around off, moves away from the wicket and shovels it past the backward point ring fielder
off-cutter ball on the leg stump, wild swing and a miss by Mondol, connects with thin air and sets off for a single

Low full toss ball on the off stump line, shuffles across and clips it aerially towards deep square leg. Sahan called for the second run straightaway, but Mondol seemed busy watching the ball, failed to respond in time and left both batters stranded at the same end. A nightmarish outing overall for Mondol on his LPL debut, hanging his partner out to dry and bringing a chaotic end to the Kaps' innings today.
